alt: Pass rate against completion tokens in log-spaced bins, one line per typical threshold plus the release arm, with a task-count table under the axis and a cap-hit column
caption: _Pass rate against how long the completion ran, per typical threshold. Every bin is joined and the y-range comes from the data, so no point falls off the axis and breaks a line. Series carry a small constant downward offset so lines that share a value can be told apart; the offset never changes the values or the counts. Cap hits are off the axis, with their counts in the right-hand column. Scored from the re-scored HumanEval rows._
label: HumanEval pass rate by completion length

alt: Pass rate against completion tokens in log-spaced bins for the typical-off arm, task-count table under the axis and a cap-hit count column at the right
caption: _MBPP pass rate against how long the completion ran. Only the typical-off arm was run: the sweep was cut after it, so this figure carries one series. Cap hits are off the axis with their counts in the right-hand column._
label: MBPP pass rate by completion length

alt: Grouped bars of the percentage of tasks passed against per-request decode speed in fixed linear tok/s bins, one bar per typical threshold plus the release arm, each labelled with its percentage
caption: _Percentage of tasks passed against per-request decode speed, in fixed linear bins, as grouped bars: several thresholds share the same rate, which lines draw on top of each other. The eval ran 4 concurrent requests, so this speed is relative to that concurrency, not the single-stream 16K figure. Cap hits are excluded from the bins, with their counts in the right-hand column. Scored from the re-scored HumanEval rows._

caption: _MBPP percentage of tasks passed against per-request decode speed, in fixed linear bins. Only the typical-off arm was run. The eval ran 4 concurrent requests, so this speed is relative to that concurrency. Cap hits are excluded from the bins, with their counts in the right-hand column._

alt: Decode tok/s for the twelve interleaved 16K windows in run order plus the typical sweep's own windows past a separator, fastest seed as the point with a min-max band, one colour per arm or threshold
caption: _The twelve interleaved 16K windows (A C D E x three rounds) in run order, then the typical sweep's own windows past the dotted separator. caption: _Decode rate against task quality, one point per operating point.
